This matter is taken up through Hybrid  arrangement (video conferencing/physical mode).
 This writ petition has been filed by the petitioner  Bhairaba Charan Sahu

challenging the communication  made by the Land Acquisition Officer, Ganjam,
 Chatrapur (opposite party no.3) dated 04.10.2024  under Annexure-4 wherein it has been held that the  compensation for the land appertaining to Khata No.73,
 Plot No.1347/1717 an area of Ac.0.040 decimals  Page 1 of 3  acquired for the project under L.A. Act, 1894 vide 4(1)
Notification No.17018 dated 27.03.2002, compensation cannot be paid under RFCTLAR&R Act, 2013 as the land acquisition process have already been completed under L.A. Act, 1894 and possession has been handed over on 23.02.2004 and therefore, the petitioner was requested by opposite party no.2 to come to the office with relevant documents pertaining to plot in question for receiving the compensation as per the previous act i.e.
Bhairaba Charan Sahu vs State Of Odisha And Others ..... ... on 7 November, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/100066270/
1 L.A. Act, 1894.

entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: It is the contention of the learned counsel for the petitioner that even though the land was acquired on 27.03.2002, no award was passed and in view of section 24 of 2013 Act which stipulates that where no award was passed under section 11 of the L.A. Act, 1894, all the provisions of 2013 Act relating to the determination of compensation shall apply and it is an admitted fact that no award has been passed.

He further argued that in the impugned communication, it is mentioned that the award was not passed in respect of the said plot as the case was sub judice in the Court, however in the representation dated 22.08.2024 vide Annexure-3, this petitioner has specifically stated that no case is pending relating to that land.
Therefore, the impugned communication dated 04.10.2024 vide Annexure-4 cannot be sustained in the eye of law.
Issue notice on the question of admission indicating therein that the matter shall be disposed of finally at the stage of admission.
Learned counsel for the State accepts notice on behalf of the opposite parties nos.1 to 3.
Three extra copies of the writ petition be served on the learned counsel for the State by tomorrow (08.11.2024).

Since Mr. Pradipta Mohanty, learned Senior Advocate appears for the opposite party no.4 Odisha Industrial Infrastructure Development Corporation usually, let a copy of the writ petition be handed over to him by tomorrow (08.11.2024).
List this matter in the week commencing from 09.12.2024 indicating the name of Mr. Pradipta Mohanty, learned Senior Advocate appearing for the opposite party no.4 in the cause list as well as at the top of the brief.
Counter affidavit, if any, be filed in the meantime.
(S.K. Sahoo) Judge (Chittaranjan Dash) Judge Signed by: RABINDRA KUMAR MISHRA
